policy: Separate archival reports; specimen and installation transfers are scored separately from exact historical checks. No observation in this ledger is a fitted level-speed target.

db601e.report: Messerschmitt V.B. 109 19 L 42, 19 September 1942, pp. 1–3 and 7
db601e.propeller: Production Me 109 F installation, three-blade VDM, 3 m
db601e.readingQualification: Use the HTML translation's 386 mph at 19,685 ft. Searchable scan text reads 522 km/h, inconsistent with that translation; the numerical speed is transcription-qualified.
db601e.transferQualification: Same engine rating and F-series propeller; G-1 airframe, radiator and intake installation differ. The source gives critical height and speed, not calibrated F-4 shaft horsepower.
db601e.archiveLead: Air Documents Division, Wright Field microfilm R 2448 F/015. F-4 W.Nr. 7640 was catalogued as EB-1; no usable matched speed/power sheet was recovered.

spitfire.report: A&AEE MA.648, Table I and §4.2 comparison
spitfire.qualification: Same mark and engine, different aircraft, SU injection pump, intake and propeller type from BS.543. Radiator flaps minimum drag.

mustang.qualification: P-51D/Mustang IV, same engine and blade drawing, different airframe and cooling configuration. +18 lb boost is close to the model's 67 inHg, not the same rating.
mustang.excluded: Mustang III FX.953 has V-1650-3 and cannot validate the V-1650-7 altitude schedule. NACA L4L18 uses a different P-51B and did not provide a validated installed power map.

thunderbolt.qualification: Prototype rather than production P-47B. Compare at reported torque-meter BHP with the frozen production polar. Cowl closed, oil and intercooler shutters neutral.

thunderboltProduction.qualification: Independent report on a separate production P-47B with the same engine and propeller. Eight guns versus six on 41-5902. TAS and torque BHP are report-table inputs; the report gives a common TAS row for the propeller climb comparison. Closed cowl/neutral shutters for speed; all shutters wide open for climb.
